thread:
sam_support: FYI customer ACME hit a big invoice spike — their SDK estimator shows ~2.1k tokens per call but server metering reports ~6.5k. Opening thread to triage. Invoice: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/2026-02-28/ACME

kayla: which invoice id and cust_id? can you paste a minimal request body we can repro with?

sam_support: cust_id: acme-inc; invoice 2026-02-28. example request we used (from customer):
```
{
  "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are an assistant."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Summarize quarterly results."}
  ]
}
```
They also used the JS SDK estimator (redwood-js .estimateTokens) and it reported ~2100 tokens.

amelia: quick FYI — the SDK estimator does not know about server-side/system injections (safety wrappers, telemetry, or contextualization added by sidecars). If a dedicated/private deployment injects extra system text that won't be counted locally by the SDK.

jordan: infra note: we rolled assistant-wrap v1.3 for a subset of Dedicated customers last week. It prepends a contextualization block (~512 tokens) and a serialized provenance header for some enterprise tenants. That could account for thousands of tokens across multi-turn flows.

sam_support: customer insists they didn't send extra system text. is there a way to confirm what hit the model?

metering-bot: autodiagnostic for req_0a1b2c3d => user_prompt: 2100, completion: 3400, system_injected: 2200, toolcall: 0, total: 7700. estimator_reported: 2100. (source: metering logs)

kayla: can infra attach the raw logged "messages" array (sanitized) for that req id? we need to prove the injection for billing and the customer.

amelia: @jordan can you dump the raw payload to #private-logs or paste a sanitized snippet here? we don't want PII in public channel.

jordan: sanitized raw payload: ```[{"role":"system","content":"<injected:contextualize v1.3>...512 tokens"}, {"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant."}, {"role":"user","content":"Summarize quarterly results."}]```

kayla: confirmed — server injected a system message before the customer's system/user messages. SDK estimator would never see that. Repro steps for SDK/support to validate locally:
1) call estimator with customer's messages array (no server injection).
2) call API via curl with same messages and the account header to reproduce server-side injection.
3) include header `x-redwood-metering-debug: true` on the API call to get a token breakdown in response headers.

sam_support: sharing sample curl for repro (customer copy):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "x-customer-id: acme-inc" \
  -H "x-redwood-metering-debug: true" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize quarterly results."}] }'
```

billing_ops: we can pause invoice adjudication for 2026-02-28 pending root-cause confirmation. need estimate of overcharge and number of affected calls.

amelia: likely root cause = assistant-wrap injection for affected tenants. action items: (1) infra to rollback or make injection opt-in per-account, (2) SDK to add a warning in estimator when account-level injections are detected (or expose a flag), (3) support to prepare credit proposal for ACME.

jordan: I'll produce an audit dump of affected reqs (IDs) and schedule a rollback for affected tenancy. ETA for rollback: 2026-03-02 02:00 UTC.

kayla: I'll draft an explanatory note for the customer describing server-side injection and offer to credit the estimated overage. Sam, please review the draft.

sam_support: draft reviewed and approved. :thumbsup:

metering-bot: follow-up created: MTR-4521 (audit & token breakdown) linking req_0a1b2c3d and invoice 2026-02-28.

billing_ops: leaving ticket open until audit confirms number of affected calls and applied credits.

jordan: dumping sanitized raw logs to #private-logs now, tagging @amelia @kayla.

kayla: will mark support ticket resolved after rollback and credits applied.

sam_support: thanks everyone — closing thread once billing confirms applied credit.
